# Ertsen

Ore exists in the ground as **deposits (nodes)**. Each node holds a limited total amount; when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates new nodes up to its configured maximum. Every ore has its own page with its extraction facts, the zones it spawns in and what is made from it. How each column is used by the server, with the node-generation formulas, is in [Ore fields](/nl/formats/ore-fields/).

**Extraction type**: 0 = solid (tile-by-tile with a drill), 1 = liquid (continuous pump). **Enabler effect** — when *required*, the robot needs the matching enabler effect active to extract that ore at all. How many nodes of each ore a zone maintains, and how large each node is, is on each ore's own page (the *Zone parameters* table there).
